author: alstvrx
quote: At its core, the game isn't awful. But for a 13-year development, 2 billion budget game? It feels disappointing in every category to me. Not to mention review sites heavily inflating its score, knowing damn well it isn't deserved. The game would likely be a 7-8 if it weren't for all the promise we got, just for multiple underwhelming missions, heavy bugs, and graphics that are just... okay. Represents everything wrong with gaming right now, too, with the increased prices and whatnot.

author: alstvrx
quote:
Changed how I thought of gaming. I've poured in hundreds, if not thousands, of hours into gacha games (while playing some PS/Nintendo games on the side), and most of the time I really just play to farm currency or achieve something. Because of how gacha games work, you're incentivised to skip anything that doesn't give you currency. Legend of Zelda is one of the first games where I WANT to talk to NPCs and learn about their lives for no incentive.

Not to mention, the level design for the temples (especially the Water Temple & Forest Temple) is clever and charming. EVERYTHING about the world is charming. The sense of progression is always very strong, something Zelda games always do well. Some may say the bosses are too easy, which I can agree with to a certain extent in earlier temples. But I actually think this is a positive thing, as it makes the game accessible to players of all ages.

There is a reason why the original was labeled one of- if not the greatest games of all time, cannot recommend it enough.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
